We’re looking for a high-accuracy, high-ownership Parabroker who thrives in a fast-paced brokerage, can make smart credit decisions, and produces flawless work.

________________________________________

THE ROLE



Purpose & Outcomes



Your job isn't simple for most but is important:

Help the broker settle more loans with fewer mistakes, faster turnaround times, and elite-level execution.



You will be responsible for handling deals from onboarding to approval, providing strategic credit analysis, structuring deals based on handover notes, and ensuring submissions are clean, complete, and positioned for approval.

 clients for outstanding items

• Conduct detailed and accurate serviceability calculations (PAYG, Self-Employed, Pension etc.)

• Review liabilities, living expenses, credit reports, bank statements & Illion data

• Complete a well organised handover detailing the results and clear path for approval.



3. Submission / Lodgement

• Understand lender input nuances

• Upload only correct & relevant documents

• Drafting strong broker notes explaining all nuances of the deal and solutions for them.

• Position the loan for approval only.

• Send docs for e-signing & follow up clients

• Maintain 
ntum to formal approval



4. MIRs (Missing Information Requests)

• Action MIRs same day as they arrive.

• Challenge incorrect MIRs using policy + evidence.

• Ensure information provided aligns with the narrative of the application before sending.

• Communicate required items to clients in a simple, non-overwhelming manner

• Prepare forms & documents to minimise client effort



5. Settlement

• Send formal approvals to client & solicitor

• Coordinate insurance (certificate of currency)

• Confirm settlement booking

• Send final settlement letter/email to client



6. Workflow + Project Work

• Update and improve workflows

• Assist with monthly broker projects

• Update spreadsheets (tracking, referral partners, contacts, continuous improvement)

________________________________________

ABOUT YOU



We hire for capacity, precision, and genuine ownership.

• Strong parabroking experience

• Strong ability to work with numbers

• Ability to process and retain large amounts of information

• Ability to complete serviceability assessments accurately

• Strong credit analysis ability

• Exceptional communication (written + verbal)

• Proactive problem-solving

• Resourcefulness — you find answers, not roadblocks

• Speed + accuracy

• Ability to produce clean, complete, well-reasoned deal files

• High quality hardware to perform your role- computer/laptop with large screen, at least one additional screen, reliable high speed internet.



Ideal (Bonus Points):

• 5+ years experience as a parabroker

• Experience with Australian mortgage aggregation software MYCRM

• Expert in using Quickly

• Immediate availability



You Are NOT a Fit If You:

• Require micromanagement

• Don't prioritise your career

• Are not growth focused

• Get overwhelmed easily

• Cannot work to high standards under pressure

________________________________________

THE BENEFITS



Compensation

• Overtime available

Work Hours

8:30am – 5:30pm AEST (Philippines: approx. 6:30am – 3:30pm)

mbers.

Growth & Career Development

• Exposure to complex deals

• Work directly with a high-performance broker

• Grow as we grow

• Own your role, own your life

• Increase your value, income and long-term opportunities

________________________________________

OUR COMPANY



Who We Are

We are a high-performance Australian mortgage brokerage that closes a large volume of deals with precision and speed. We work fast, think strategically, and expect excellence — because our clients and partners rely on us for outcomes, not excuses.



Our Culture

(Hybrid role – TIKC & GovCon iSource Clients)



About Us



At Team Integrity Knowledge Center (TIKC) and GovCon iSource, we’re on a mission to shake up the way businesses enter and thrive in government contracting. We create resources, community spaces, and premium client experiences that help small businesses scale and win in one of the most competitive arenas out there: GovCon.

This is not your average “manager” role. We’re looking for someone who wears multiple hats and thrives on variety. You’ll be part community-builder, part client champion, and part storyteller. You’ll support our members, keep our project management boards moving, and make our social presence engaging and impossible to ignore.



You’ll be the person who:



Builds trust and relationships with our members and clients (Community Manager).



Provides premium, empathetic, and proactive support that makes people say “wow” (Customer Service Manager).



Creates and manages fresh, engaging, and strategic content that elevates our brand (Social Media Manager).

Community Management:



Grow, engage, and support our online community of entrepreneurs and GovCon professionals.



Host and moderate conversations, webinars, and small-group discussions.



Be the bridge between our members and the resources they need.

Create systems that make our clients feel valued, heard, and supported.



Help us refine and elevate the customer journey.



Social Media:



Create fun marketing ideas, support our marketing team, and assist with marketing output

Manage YouTube and social media platforms



Project Management:



Keep our internal project boards (think: 
/Trello/Asana/ClickUp) organized and moving.



Coordinate across teams to ensure deliverables are on time.



Help us track wins, challenges, and opportunities.



What You Bring



Curiosity and eagerness to learn about government contracting (experience is a bonus, but not required).



A love for people—whether it’s supporting customers, building communities, or engaging online.



Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.



Comfort with project management tools and staying organized.



Adaptability to work with a diverse, fast-paced, and high-performing team.



A “let’s figure it out” attitude—resourceful, proactive, and unafraid of challenges.



What You’ll Gain



GovCon Knowledge: You’ll get a crash course in government contracting—an industry that’s recession-proof and packed with opportunities.



Customer Service Mastery: You’ll refine premium client-care skills that stand out on any resume.



Project Management: Real experience managing boards, workflows, and cross-functional teams.



Social Media Strategy: Hands-on learning in creating content that drives real business growth.



A Killer Resume Boost: You’ll walk away with multi-disciplinary experience in three highly valuable fields.



Why Join Us?



We believe in growth—for our clients, our team, and you. We’re not looking for someone to “just do tasks.” We want a teammate who wants to evolve, try new things, and carve out a meaningful career path in GovCon, customer service, and digital communications.



This is your chance to grow into a role where you can make an impact, gain insider knowledge in a billion-dollar industry, and join a team that actually cares about your future.

title: Senior Figma Web Designer (Custom Premium Sites for AU Agency)
description:
We are Northstar Growth, an Australian SEO and web development agency. We build custom websites for Registered Training Organisations and B2B service businesses across Australia.

Our designs are not template-based. They are custom from scratch, every time. We use Figma for design and Bricks Builder (WordPress) for development.

We are hiring one specialist Figma designer. This is a design-only role. We are not looking for a hybrid designer/developer. We tried that. They were mediocre at both. If your portfolio is full of Dribbble shots or Relume-style templates, this role is not for you.



What you will do:



Design custom websites in Figma for our clients

Use components, variants, auto-layout, and design tokens (typography, color, spacing)

Build responsive layouts (desktop, tablet, mobile)

Organise files for clean developer handoff to Bricks Builder

Take a brief, ask smart questions, and produce a first draft that needs minimal revision



Must Haves:



3+ years of Figma web design experience (not app UI only)

Portfolio of real shipped websites with live URLs (not Dribbble shots)

Strong grasp of typography, spacing, hierarchy, and visual taste

Clean Figma file structure with proper component systems

Fluent written English

Reliable internet and ability to do Loom walkthroughs

Some overlap with Australian business hours (AEST is only 2 hours ahead of PHT)



Nice to Have:



Familiarity with Bricks Builder or WordPress page builders

Conversion-focused design thinking

Experience with consulting, training, or professional service brand styling



Compensation:



Paid trial first: $75 USD flat for a 2-3 hour trial brief

Then ongoing work paid as $1,200 to $1,500 USD per month retainer for 12-15 pages, or $75 USD per fully-designed page if you prefer project-based

We pay fast via Wise on the 15th and 30th of each month

13th month bonus in December after 6 months of consistent work

Performance raises after 6 months



What is in it for you:



Consistent work for a proven performer. We have a steady pipeline of client sites.

Long-term relationship. We are not looking for a one-off freelancer.

Clean briefs, fast feedback, no chaos.



How to Apply:

Read this carefully. Applications that skip any step will be deleted.



Start your application with the word BRICKS at the top.

Send 3 portfolio examples. Each must include a live URL of the shipped site and a Figma file link (view access).

Record a 3-5 minute Loom video walking through ONE of those projects. Show the Figma file. Explain your component system, your auto-layout choices, and one design decision you debated.

Answer this question in 2-3 sentences: When designing a hero section for a professional services company, what are the three most important decisions you make first, and why?

State your preferred pay structure (per-page or monthly retainer) and your weekly availability in hours.

Use 10 Apply Points on this application.



Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed. Applications without live URLs will not be reviewed. Applications that do not start with the word BRICKS will not be reviewed.

If you are a serious Figma specialist who wants stable, long-term, well-paid design work with an agency that respects design, apply now.

title: Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager

# Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager



## About Us



We’re an AI-first marketing agency based in Australia, focused on performance, systems, innovation, and building things properly.

We are looking for someone who can think independently, identify problems, improve systems, take ownership, and help us scale.



This is not a junior role.



This is a long-term role for somebody who wants to grow with the company and become a core part of the team.



---



## The Role



We are hiring a full-time Paid Media & Marketing Operations Manager.



Your role will involve managing campaigns, improving systems, building reporting processes, working with AI tools, solving operational problems, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients.



You will work directly with the founder and become heavily involved in the operational side of the agency.

* launching Meta campaigns

* optimising Google Ads campaigns

* improving reporting systems

* troubleshooting tracking issues

* improving attribution accuracy

* helping build AI workflows

* auditing landing pages

* improving internal systems

* managing Shopify marketing tasks

* identifying inefficiencies before anybody else notices them



We value initiative very highly.



You should already be comfortable independently launching and managing campaigns.



If you wait to be told every small step, this role is not for you.



---



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



* Setting up and managing Google Ads campaigns

* Setting up and managing Meta Ads campaigns

* Monitoring performance and improving campaign results

* Creating and improving reporting systems

* Building dashboards and client reporting workflows

* Setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking

* Managing Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, and Events Manager setups

* Diagnosing tracking issues and ensuring accurate attribution

* Working with AI tools to improve efficiency

* Assisting with SEO-related tasks and strategy

* Helping improve agency systems and operations

* Identifying problems proactively and solving them independently

* Supporting onboarding workflows for new clients

* Working with Shopify stores where required

* Providing weekly campaign updates and operational updates



Potential future client-facing opportunities are available for candidates with exceptional communication skills and presentation ability.



---



## What We’re Looking For



### Required Skills



* Strong Google Ads experience

* Strong Meta Ads experience

* Good understanding of performance marketing

* Understanding of marketing reporting and analytics

* Comfortable using AI tools daily

* Ability to think independently and solve problems

* Strong written English communication

* Organised and systems-oriented

* High attention to detail



### Highly Valued



* Experience with Shopify

* Experience with GoHighLevel

* Strong understanding of Google Tag Manager

* Strong understanding of GA4

* Experience setting up and troubleshooting Meta Pixel and Events Manager

* Experience with attribution and conversion tracking

* Experience with automation tools like Zapier or Make

* Experience using AI builders/tools such as Lovable

* Basic SEO understanding

* Design eye and understanding of good creative



---



## Growth Opportunity



We are building this role for the long term.



As the company grows, this position will continue to grow and evolve with it.



For the right person, there is significant opportunity for:



* increased responsibility

* leadership opportunities

* involvement in higher-level strategy

* direct collaboration with the founder

* long-term career growth inside the company



This is a remote-first role, however for exceptional long-term tea
mbers, there may also be opportunities over the next 12 to 24 months to become more directly involved with the Australian side of the business if desired.



We are looking for somebody who wants to build something long-term, not somebody looking for a short-term freelance position.



---



## The Type of Person That Will Succeed Here



You:



* take initiative without being asked

* enjoy solving problems

* improve systems naturally

* think critically

* learn quickly

* communicate clearly

* care about results

* want long-term growth

* are comfortable in a fast-moving environment

* use AI to work smarter and faster



You probably will NOT enjoy this role if:



* you need constant supervision

* you wait for instructions for every task

* you avoid ownership

* you struggle with communication

* you prefer repetitive admin-only work



---



## Hours



* Full-time role

* Flexible scheduling where needed

* Must have overlap with Melbourne business hours



---



## To Apply



Please answer the following carefully.



We are not looking for perfect answers. We are looking for your thinking process, problem-solving ability, and how you approach challenges.



### Question 1



Tell us about a marketing or operational problem you noticed before anybody else did.



How did you identify it?

What did you do to solve it?

What was the result?



### Question 2

* what you would check first

* how you would investigate the issue

* what data you would look at

* what actions you would take



We care far more about your thinking process than having a “perfect” answer.

As the Senior Webflow Developer, you will work closely with the CEO to lead the build and delivery of client projects from start to finish. You will take Figma designs, creative briefs, and strategic direction and turn them into premium, high-performing websites in Webflow.



This is not a support role. You will own the development side of every project, manage your own workload across multiple active builds, and be trusted to deliver without constant oversight. Over time, you will take on direct client communication and become a key part of how uBloom operates and grows.



This role suits someone who is highly skilled, self-directed, and genuinely proud of the work they put out. You care about the details, you communicate clearly, and you want to be part of something that is building toward something real.



uBloom is a growing creative and digital studio working with premium architecture, construction, and lifestyle brands. This role offers the opportunity to become deeply embedded in the business, develop strong development and project management skills, and take on increased responsibility over time. Prior experience is essential; a strong work ethic, sound judgement, and willingness to be part of the team are key.



Time requirement



9am - 6pm Brisbane Time (1 hour lunch)

Monday - Friday

13th Month Included

Australia Holiday Schedule



Responsibilities



Client project delivery



- Take completed Figma designs and build them in Webflow to a premium, pixel-accurate standard

- Develop custom interactions and animations using GSAP and native Webflow to a high level of polish

- Write clean JavaScript to extend functionality beyond native Webflow where required

- Work from partial briefs or design direction and apply enough design judgement to execute independently

- Manage multiple active projects simultaneously inside Notion without losing detail or missing deadlines

- Handle DNS configuration, domain setup, and full site launches independently



Existing project management



- Audit and clean up Webflow projects inherited from previous developers

- Restructure class names, organise styles, and implement cleaner development systems into existing builds

- Fix bugs, resolve layout and interaction issues, and improve overall project quality

- Implement website changes, new features, and additional functionality onto live client websites

- Navigate complex Webflow projects calmly and methodically without breaking what already works



Internal systems and frameworks



- Help build and refine uBloom's internal Webflow frameworks and component systems

- Contribute to the development of repeatable build processes that improve speed and consistency across projects

- Assist in building and improving internal task management systems inside Notion

- Document processes clearly so systems can be followed, improved, and handed over where needed



Standards and organisation



- Maintain clean, organised class naming conventions across every project without being asked

- Structure Webflow projects for long-term maintainability from the very first build session

- Communicate progress proactively, flag blockers early, and keep work moving without being chased

- Follow and actively contribute to uBloom's internal SOPs and build processes



Requirements for consideration



- 4+ years Webflow experience with a strong portfolio of premium, design-forward builds

- Advanced GSAP skills used regularly and confidently across real client projects

- Include an animal that best represents you in the subject line (required)

- Solid JavaScript ability for custom interactions, logic, and extended functionality

- Strong Figma-to-Webflow workflow with the design understanding to fill gaps independently

- Demonstrated ability to audit, clean up, and improve Webflow projects built by others

- A disciplined, consistent approach to class naming and project organisation

- Experience managing DNS settings and handling full site launches without support

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of quality

Systems minded. You think about how to do things in a repeatable, scalable way, not just how to get the current task done

- Clear, professional written communication in English

- Reliable internet connection and consistent availability during agreed working hours

- Familiarity with Notion for project and task management

- Finsweet attributes experience is optional but a good advantage

- This must be your only role. Exclusive commitment is required



Why you’ll love working at uBloom Digital



This role goes well beyond executing tasks from a list. This is a fully remote role where you will be trusted with real responsibility from day one. You will be given genuine ownership over your work and the space to do it well. The work you build will be seen by hundreds of thousands of eyeballs across Australia and will directly shape how our high-end clients businesses grow and compete.



Culture matters at uBloom. We are a small, tight team that takes the work seriously but does not take itself too seriously. We care about quality, we move fast, and we back the people we work with. Outside of work the founders and team are into fitness, sport, health, and generally having a fun lifestyle, and we think that balance matters.



As the business grows, there is a real opportunity to grow with it. We value long-term relationships, reliability, and people who want to keep getting better. Initiative is rewarded with more responsibility, better projects, and progression over time. If you want to do some of the best work of your career inside a thoughtful and ambitious agency, this role is for you.



Compensation



$1800 USD per month

13th Month Guaranteed



Overall, we are looking for a person with a positive attitude, professionalism, reliability, great time management skills, open communication, and a passion to learn! If this is you or someone you know, please apply with your resume and cover letter

To initiate the application process, kindly submit your application here:









Secondary Employment & Conflict of Interest Policy



Serenity Clean

To protect the interests, confidential information, and business relationships of Serenity Clean, employees are expected to avoid conflicts of interest related to secondary employment.



Policy Statement

Employees of Serenity Clean may engage in secondary employment only if such employment does not create a conflict of interest, interfere with job performance, or compromise the confidentiality, integrity, or reputation of Serenity Clean.



Prohibited Secondary Employment

Employees may not hold secondary employment, contract work, consulting roles, or ownership interests that:

Are within the same industry as Serenity Clean

Are with a direct or indirect competitor of Serenity Clean

Involve businesses offering similar or overlapping services

Create the potential for misuse or disclosure of Serenity Clean’s confidential or proprietary information

Present a risk of divided loyalty, including the sharing of leads, pricing, financial data, or internal processes

This prohibition applies regardless of whether the secondary role is full-time, part-time, contract-based, freelance, paid, or unpaid.



Disclosure Requirement

All employees are required to fully and accurately disclose any current or planned secondary employment during:

The interview and hiring process

Employment with Serenity Clean, if circumstances change

Failure to disclose secondary employment, or misrepresentation of employment status, may result in disciplinary action, up to and including immediate termination.



Confidentiality and Loyalty

Employees must not use Serenity Clean time, resources, systems, or information for outside work. Access to company financials, client information, pricing, leads, or internal strategies must be protected at all times.



Enforcement

Violation of this policy will be considered a serious breach of trust and company policy and may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

title: Customer Service Manager (Highly Experience with 8 Figure ECOM BRANDS)
description:
Ecommerce Brand Doing $3M+/Month



This is not a basic support role.



We are looking for a highly experienced Customer Support Manager who can manage, optimize, and improve a high-volume customer support operation inside a fast-growing ecommerce brand.



This role is for someone who understands that customer support is not just answering tickets. It directly impacts retention, refunds, chargebacks, disputes, BBB complaints, Trustpilot reviews, customer experience, and overall profitability.



About Us



We operate a subscription-based ecommerce brand in the supplements space, currently doing $3M+/month and scaling aggressively.



We move fast, care deeply about retention, and need a Customer Support Manager who can bring structure, accountability, reporting, and strategic thinking to the team.



Your Role



You will be responsible for managing and improving the customer support operation.



Your job is to make sure the team is performing at a high level, customers are being handled properly, refunds and replacements are tracked correctly, and support issues are being used to improve the business.



We are looking for someone who can think strategically, spot problems before they become bigger issues, and bring ideas to improve the customer experience and reduce risk.



What You’ll Be Responsible For

Daily Customer Support Management



Manage the day-to-day performance of the support team

Monitor ticket queues and make sure customer issues are handled quickly and correctly

Review agent performance and hold the team accountable

Make sure escalations are handled properly

Ensure refunds, replacements, cancellations, and customer complaints are tracked correctly

Identify weak points in the support process and improve them



High-Risk Customer Issues



Manage sensitive customer issues before they turn into chargebacks, disputes, BBB complaints, Trustpilot complaints, or negative reviews

Create systems to reduce refund abuse, disputes, and chargebacks

Review high-risk tickets and escalations

Make sure the team is using the right language when handling sensitive customer complaints

Track the root causes of complaints and report them clearly



Retention & Revenue Protection



Improve customer retention through better support processes

Identify why customers cancel, refund, dispute, or complain

Build better save flows, macros, and escalation processes

Work with the team to reduce unnecessary refunds and replacements

Help protect revenue while still maintaining a strong customer experience



Reporting & KPI Tracking



This is a very important part of the role.



You must be strong with reporting, tracking, and using data to improve the support team.



You will be responsible for tracking and reporting on:



CSAT

First response time

Resolution time

Average handle time

Refund rates

Replacement rates

Cancellation reasons

Chargeback and dispute trends

Common customer complaints

Agent performance

Escalation volume

Trustpilot, BBB, and review-related issues



You should be able to look at support data and tell us what is broken, what needs to improve, and what actions should be taken.



Macros, SOPs & Systems



Build and improve macros, templates, and SOPs

Create clear processes for refunds, replacements, escalations, cancellations, chargeback prevention, BBB complaints, and Trustpilot complaints

Audit the team to make sure SOPs are being followed

Continuously improve the support system as the company scales

Make sure the team is consistent in tone, accuracy, speed, and decision-making



Coaching & Quality Assurance



Coach support agents to improve quality, speed, and resolution

Audit tickets regularly and give clear feedback

Identify weak agents and performance issues quickly

Improve team consistency through scorecards, training, and QA reviews

Make sure agents understand how to handle difficult customers without creating more risk



Strategy & Continuous Improvement



We are not looking for someone who only reacts to problems.



We want someone who can think, improve, and bring ideas.



You should be able to identify patterns, suggest better systems, improve customer experience, reduce risk, and help make the support team stronger every month.



Requirements



You must have experience working with an 8-figure ecommerce brand

You must name the ecommerce brand or brands you have worked with

Strong customer support management experience

Experience managing high-volume ecommerce support teams

Experience with refunds, chargebacks, disputes, BBB complaints, Trustpilot, or other high-risk customer issues

Strong understanding of retention, customer experience, and revenue protection

Strong reporting and KPI tracking ability

Experience building macros, SOPs, QA systems, and support processes

Experience using Shopify

Experience with CheckoutChamp is preferred

Excellent written and spoken English

Full-time availability

Strong attention to detail

Ability to move fast and take ownership



Who You Are



You think in systems, not just tickets

You understand that customer support impacts revenue, retention, and risk

You are strong with reporting and numbers

You know how to manage high-risk customer issues calmly and professionally

You can spot weak processes and fix them

You can coach agents and improve team performance

You bring ideas, not just updates

You take ownership and do not need to be micromanaged



Compensation



Competitive base depending on experience

Performance incentives available for the right person

Long-term opportunity inside a fast-growing ecommerce brand



How to Apply



Please answer the following 5 questions:



What 8-figure ecommerce brand or brands have you worked with? Please include the brand names and your role.

What was the size of the customer support team you managed, and what ticket volume were you responsible for?

What experience do you have managing high-risk customer issues such as chargebacks, disputes, BBB complaints, Trustpilot complaints, refunds, or escalations?

What KPIs and reports have you managed for customer support? Please mention anything related to CSAT, resolution time, first response time, average handle time, refund rates, chargebacks, or agent performance.

What SOPs, macros, QA systems, or retention processes have you built or improved in a previous ecommerce role?

Final Note



If you have only answered tickets, this role is not for you.



We are looking for someone who can manage, improve, and strategically lead a customer support operation for a fast-growing ecommerce brand.

Overview:

We are an AI-powered lifestyle management platform built for the world’s highest-performance founders, athletes, and family offices. Think of it as the operating system for someone’s entire personal life, travel, dining, exclusive experiences, luxury goods, and wellness all managed in one place by a team that genuinely goes the extra mile. 



This is a role with a real growth path. If you want to grow into a leadership position, not just do a job, strong performers here will be the first in line to step up as the team scales.



What This Role Actually Looks Like

Here’s a concrete example. A member is flying to New York for three days. Their itinerary: check in to the Four Seasons, dinner at Nobu, a visit to the Met.

A good assistant books those things. You do something different.



You call the Four Seasons’ guest relations team, build a quick rapport, and arrange for two bottles of Dom Pérignon to be waiting in the room with a handwritten welcome card from the company.

Nobu is fully booked. You find the right contact, introduce yourself professionally, and get the table anyway — because you know how to talk to people who matter.

You reach out to the Met’s private tours team and arrange for a dedicated art historian to personally guide the member through the galleries, with refreshments waiting.



That’s the standard. Every member, every trip.



IMPORTANT: Please carefully read the responsibilities section below to ensure you’re a good fit, and follow the instructions on how to apply at the bottom

*Competitive salary: $1,400 – $1,500 USD per month (depending on experience)

Core Responsibilities

* Take a member’s confirmed plans and elevate them, coordinating room amenities, securing hard-to-get reservations, arranging private access, and adding personal touches that make the experience extraordinary.

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, venues, and luxury service providers in the US, UK, and beyond. Representing the company with confidence and professionalism on every call.

* Build and maintain genuine relationships with our partner network so that we get access, prioritisation, and goodwill that others don’t.

* Document member preferences, request history, and partner interactions in our systems every time, without being reminded.

* Grow into a leadership position as the department scales. Strong performers will take on increasing ownership of the Lifestyle Manager function.

You’re Perfect for This Role If You

Here’s a concrete example. A member is flying to New York for three days. Their itinerary: check in to the Four Seasons, dinner at Nobu, a visit to the Met.

A good assistant books those things. You do something different.



You call the Four Seasons’ guest relations team, build a quick rapport, and arrange for two bottles of Dom Pérignon to be waiting in the room with a handwritten welcome card from the company.

Nobu is fully booked. You find the right contact, introduce yourself professionally, and get the table anyway — because you know how to talk to people who matter.

You reach out to the Met’s private tours team and arrange for a dedicated art historian to personally guide the member through the galleries, with refreshments waiting.



That’s the standard. Every member, every trip.

*Competitive salary: $1,400 – $1,500 USD per month (depending on experience)

*Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (EST)

Core Responsibilities

* Take a member’s confirmed plans and elevate them, coordinating room amenities, securing hard-to-get reservations, arranging private access, and adding personal touches that make the experience extraordinary.

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, venues, and luxury service providers in the US, UK, and beyond. Representing the company with confidence and professionalism on every call.

* Grow into a leadership position as the department scales. Strong performers will take on increasing ownership of the Lifestyle Manager function.

You’re Perfect for This Role If You

*Have 3+ years in a high-touch, client-facing role serving wealthy or high-profile principals — whether as a personal or executive assistant to a CEO, a VIP or guest relations manager at a five-star location (e.g. The Peninsula Manila, Shangri-La, Solaire, Raffles), or a client relations manager at a luxury brand (e.g. LVMH, Richemont, Rustan’s).

title: Video Editor
description:
EDITOR — VIDEO AD CREATIVES



Niche: Beauty / Skincare (Korean-inspired Anti-Aging)



**Location:** Remote (Asia, Philippines)

**Type:** Full-Time Contractor

**Reports to:** Head of Editors

**Compensation:** $800–$1,000/month (depending on experience and region)



---



We're looking for a Performance Editor to cut high-converting video ad creatives for Meta 
 & Instagram), primarily from UGC footage, hooks, and raw content.



Our brand is in the beauty and skincare space and we are only hiring editors with 2+ years of experience in performance video editing, direct response ads, or social media content editing.



This is NOT a "make things look cinematic" job. This is a marketing-first editing role. Every cut, every caption, every transition exists to stop the scroll and drive the click.



You will receive from our Creative Strategist: briefs, hooks, raw footage, UGC clips, voiceovers, and reference ads. Your job is to turn these into multiple creative variations built for testing and scaling.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will edit video ad creatives for Meta feeds, stories, and reels. You will cut hook variations from the same raw footage. You will add captions, motion text, and on-screen callouts that drive clarity and attention. You will produce multiple variations from a single brief. You will maintain a fast revision turnaround and keep files organized. You will work closely with the Creative Strategist — briefs come from them, performance feedback loops back to them.



HOW WE EVALUATE YOUR WORK



We look at whether you can make the first 2-3 seconds impossible to scroll past. We look at whether you can turn one piece of footage into multiple distinct variations. We look at whether you prioritize message clarity over visual complexity. We look at whether you can follow a brief precisely and iterate fast. We look at whether you produce volume without sacrificing quality.



EXPECTED OUTPUT



You should be able to deliver multiple finalized edits and variations per week, execute fast revisions based on performance data, and maintain clean organized project files.



YOU HAVE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH:



Using AI softwares to create AI avatars, AI b-roll clips, AI voiceovers and many more. You have to be very familiar with AI and interested in learning more about it and how to integrated more into your work.



TOOLS



We use CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or equivalent. Notion for task management and communication.



IN ADDITION to base pay, you will receive performance-based bonuses on winning Meta ads.



IMPORTANT



Please apply only if you have at least 2 years of relevant experience in video editing for paid ads or performance content. Include samples of ad creatives, UGC edits, or Meta video ads in your application. No portfolio = no review.

description:

Foreclosure Assistance Specialist

Direct Employer | Remote

Rate: $5–$6/hour (based on experience)



Role Overview:

As a Foreclosure Assistance Specialist, you will speak with homeowners who are seeking help in

postponing or extending their foreclosure/auction date. You will guide them through our services,

How to Apply:



 your CV to 

Subject line: SAP – Foreclosure Assistance Specialist – [Your Name]

Attach a link to your voice recording reading the article below using 



1. What Is a Foreclosure Postponement?

“Many homeowners facing foreclosure are unaware that they may qualify for a postponement. A foreclosure postponement is a temporary delay granted by the county or court, giving the homeowner more time to gather documents, explore loss-mitigation options, or secure financial assistance. This extra time can be crucial, especially when homeowners are dealing with unexpected hardships. Understanding the process and deadlines is essential to increasing the chances of a successful postponement.”

2. Why Acting Early Matters in Foreclosure Situations

“When a homeowner receives a Notice of Default or an auction date, time becomes their most valuable resource. Acting early allows them to review options such as negotiating with their lender, filing for postponement, or exploring repayment plans. Many homeowners wait until the last few weeks, which limits their options. Early action can reduce stress and significantly improve the outcome of their case.”

3. The Importance of Verified Court Filings in Foreclosure Cases

“Submitting accurate and timely court filings can make a big difference in a foreclosure situation. Counties require specific documents, strict formatting, and deadlines that must be met exactly. Missing a requirement can cause delays or an automatic denial. That’s why many homeowners choose to work with assistance programs that specialize in preparing and filing documents on their behalf. Proper filing helps homeowners buy valuable time and avoid losing their property prematurely.”

4. Understanding Your Rights as a Homeowner Facing Foreclosure

“Homeowners facing foreclosure often feel overwhelmed, but it is important to remember that they still have rights. They have the right to receive proper notice, the right to request information from their lender, and in many cases, the right to seek postponement or review options. Knowing these rights helps homeowners make informed decisions rather than reacting out of fear. Education and support can make the process less intimidating.”

title: Content Manager
description:
CONTENT MANAGER

Remote · Part-Time to Full-Time · Long-Term

Tony Richards · Renaissance Properties LLC · Montgomery, Alabama USA



WHO YOU'D BE WORKING FOR

My name is Tony Richards. I'm a real estate investor and entrepreneur based in Montgomery, Alabama. I've been building for 20+ years — 300+ rental doors, 60+ Airbnb units, and 8 active companies including a property management operation, auto dealerships, a roll-off dumpster company, and a wholesale distribution warehouse.



I also have a growing personal brand with 18,000+
 followers and tens of thousands of views on content I create around real estate, wealth building, and faith-driven entrepreneurship. People follow me because I show them the real operation — not theory, not fluff.



I'm building out a content engine — social media, a paid subscription, digital courses, and a high-ticket mentorship program. I need a right-hand person to run the content side so I can stay focused on operating my companies.



THE ROLE

This is not a social media poster job. This is a Content Manager role — the person who takes everything I'm already doing and turns it into organized, scheduled, on-brand content across all platforms and revenue streams.

Your core job:

• Watch raw video footage I send you and d
 how to use it — what becomes a free Reel, what becomes subscription content, what becomes course material

• Write captions, scripts, and overlay text in my exact voice and brand tone

• Brief my video editor (Frans) on exactly how to cut each piece

• Manage the monthly content calendar — what posts on what day, on what platform

• Upload exclusive content to my
 Subscription page on schedule

• Monitor comments and DMs, flag anything that needs my personal response

• Keep everything organized so nothing falls through the cracks



WHAT A TYPICAL WEEK LOOKS LIKE

• Monday: Review raw footage from the weekend, plan the week's content

• Tuesday–Thursday: Write captions, brief Frans, schedule posts via Meta Business Suite

• Friday: Upload that week's exclusive subscriber video, prep next week's calendar

• Ongoing: Monitor comments, track engagement, flag high-performing content for repurposing

Estimated hours: 20–30 per week to start, growing to full-time as the operation scales.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This role is for someone who is organized, proactive, and takes ownership. If you need constant direction, this is not the right fit.

You must have:

• Proven experience managing social media content for a personal brand, entrepreneur, or business

• Strong English writing skills — you will be writing in someone else's voice daily

• Experience with Meta Business Suite or similar scheduling tools

• Understanding of short-form video content (Reels, TikTok-style content)

• Ability to identify what makes content perform — hooks, captions, timing

• Highly organized — you will manage a content calendar across multiple platforms

• Self-starter who communicates proactively and hits deadlines without being chased

Bonus points if you have:

• Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

• Experience with Canva or basic graphic tools

• Background in real estate, investing, or financial content

• Experience managing a paid subscription community (Patreon,
 Subscriptions, etc.)



WHAT YOU WON'T BE DOING

You will not be filming content — I handle that.

You will not be editing video — Frans handles that.

You will not be doing property management or anything related to my real estate companies.

You will not be expected to work US business hours — results matter, not when you're at your desk.



COMPENSATION

Starting: $500–$800 USD/month (part-time) · $900–$1,400 USD/month (full-time) · Based on experience and output quality



This is a long-term role with real growth potential. As my brand and revenue scales, your compensation scales with it. I'm not looking for someone to fill a seat — I'm looking for someone who wants to grow with an operation that is already moving.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, your application must include ALL of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



• Your resume or work history

• 2–3 examples of social media content you have managed or written (links or screenshots)

• A short paragraph — in your own words — explaining why you are the right person for this role

• Answer this question: You receive a 4-minute raw video of a real estate investor walking through a house flip in progress, talking about what's been spent so far. What would you do with it? Be specific.

That last question is the most important part of your application. It tells me immediately whether you understand this role.



TONY RICHARDS · RENAISSANCE PROPERTIES LLC

Montgomery, Alabama USA

title: Conversion Web Operator (WordPress + Elementor)
description:
POSITION: Conversion Web Operator (WordPress + Elementor)

COMPANY: IT Tech Industry

TYPE: Full-Time, Remote

SALARY: $1,000-$1,200 / month



---



You don't wait for a designer to hand you a mockup. You read the brief, open Elementor, and build.



You know where the CTA goes before anyone tells you. You know why the headline matters more than the hero image. You check the mobile view without being asked. And when the page goes live, you already know what you'd test first.



If that's how you work, keep reading.



---



THE ROLE



Our company is a U.S.-based IT and cybersecurity company. We help small, mid to enterpise businesses stay secure, compliant, and running. Our SEO team generates organic traffic — your job is to make sure that traffic converts.



You will build and optimize landing pages in WordPress using Elementor. You will receive a brief. You will ship the page. Fast, clean, and built to convert. Every page you touch gets tracked in GA4. The data tells us if you're doing your job. So does the revision count.



---



WHAT YOUR WEEK LOOKS LIKE



- You receive page briefs with keyword targets, CTA goals, and structure notes

- You build or optimize 3+ pages from brief to live — desktop and mobile, both done right

- You can on-page SEO yourself: headings, meta, keyword placement, internal links

- You do not ask "what should it look like?" — you have instincts and you use them

- You submit delivery with a SEO Tools or call

- Friday: pages shipped, revision count, and any conversion data you tracked



---



THE STANDARD



This is not a goal. This is the floor:



- 3 pages shipped per week, atleast

- Every page live within 24 hours of an approved brief

- Maximum 2 revisions per deliverable — lower is better

- Measurable CTR or lead improvement on pages you optimize



If 24 hours feels too fast, this role will be frustrating. If it feels normal, we want to talk.



---



YOU ARE THE RIGHT FIT IF



- You have built landing pages in Elementor and can send us the live URLs right now

- You understand conversion — not just design. You know the difference between a page that looks good and a page that converts.

- You do on-page SEO as a default, not as an afterthought

- You deliver first drafts that are 90% there, not rough sketches that need three rounds of feedback

- You communicate when there's a blocker and solve it without being chased



---



YOU ARE NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF



- Every page you build starts with "can you send me a reference design?"

- You have never looked at GA4 to understand how a page is performing

- You treat SEO and design as two separate things that someone else handles

- Your average delivery time is "a few days" with no specific timeline







---



TEST TASK — NON-NEGOTIABLE



after interview, you will complete a short test task using real company context. You will build one above-the-fold section in Elementor — live link or video walkthrough required. No static screenshots accepted.



Details are sent after your application is reviewed. If you skip it, your application closes.



---



HOW TO APPLY:




: 

with the subject line: WEB OPERATOR — [Your Name]



Do not send a resume as your first message. Send this instead:



1. Two or three live URLs of landing pages you personally built in Elementor.

2. For one of those pages — tell us in two sentences what you would change to improve its conversion rate today.

3. Your available start date.

Confident on both written and phone channels — async for documentation; phone for hard conversations and relationship work.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant - Global Accounting Operations

Senior Revenue Accountant – Global Accounting Operations

THE COMPANY



DTiQ is a fast-growing global leader in intelligent video-based surveillance and loss prevention solutions, helping businesses improve operations and protect their assets. With over 20 years of experience and more than 45,000 customers worldwide—including well-known brands like Adidas, Burger King, Hard Rock Café, KFC, McDonald’s, US Polo, and Yankee Candle—DTiQ supports over 8 million customer experiences every day.

For more information on DTiQ visit our website (
) or our LinkedIn page (www.
/company/dtiq).



THE ROLE



Application Link: 



We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Revenue Accountant to join our growing global finance organization. This role is an exciting opportunity for an accounting professional in the Philippines who wants to build deep expertise in revenue accounting, US GAAP compliance, and multinational financial operations within a fast-paced international environment.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical accounting knowledge, hands-on NetSuite experience, and the ability to collaborate across multiple regions and business functions. You will play a critical role in ensuring accurate revenue reporting, maintaining compliance with ASC 606 standards, and supporting global accounting and audit activities across international subsidiaries.



Key Responsibilities

• Manage and support Revenue Recognition processes in compliance with ASC 606, ensuring accurate and timely recognition of revenue across multiple entities and revenue streams.

• Administer and maintain revenue accounting activities using NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), including revenue schedules, contract mapping, and system validations.

• Oversee NetSuite item setup and maintenance, ensuring proper accounting treatment, revenue mapping, and alignment with operational and reporting requirements.

• Prepare, review, and document monthly US GAAP to Local GAAP reconciliations, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and compliance across international reporting requirements.

• Perform detailed Intercompany Reconciliations, including transfer pricing markups, cross-border transactions, and elimination support to ensure accurate global consolidation.

• Support the preparation of annual audit requirements, including schedules, supporting documentation, and auditor inquiries.

• Assist in the drafting and preparation of financial statements and related disclosures.

• Partner with global accounting, FP&A, tax, and operational teams to improve revenue processes and strengthen internal controls.

• Contribute to month-end close activities, process improvements, and accounting automation initiatives.



Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Finance, or related discipline; CPA preferred.

• 5+ years of progressive accounting or revenue accounting experience in a multinational or shared services environment.

• Strong knowledge of US GAAP, particularly ASC 606 Revenue Recognition principles.

• Hands-on experience with NetSuite ARM (Advanced Revenue Management) is highly preferred.

• Experience supporting global entities and multi-currency accounting environments.

• Strong understanding of intercompany accounting and consolidation processes.

• Experience supporting annual external audits and financial statement preparation.

• Excellent analytical, reconciliation, and documentation skills with strong attention to detail.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across international teams.



Why This Role?

• Exposure to global accounting operations and international business environments

• Opportunity to work with senior finance leadership

• Career growth in a high-impact accounting role

• Collaborative and supportive global culture

• Competitive compensation and benefits package



If you are a proactive accounting professional looking to expand your international finance experience and make a meaningful impact in a global organization, we’d love to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.



Application Link:



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates. The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).



Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment. This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity, but allows us to comply with legal regulations. This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day to day with our team. Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations. Your formal contract will come from Ripping and DTiQ will manager your daily work, performance and career development. If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you.

title: Pinterest Organic Growth Specialist
description:
Adventure Travel Brand - Long-Term Role



Before you apply - please read carefully



This role is 100% organic Pinterest. No Pinterest Ads. If your expertise is paid campaigns, this is not for you.



You must specialise in Pinterest. General social media managers who cover five platforms will not be considered.



Travel, gifting, or e-commerce experience is strongly preferred.



This is a long-term role. We are building this channel over years, not weeks. We are looking for a minimum 2-year commitment from you.



You must be available to work consistently 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.



About Us

This Big World is an adventure travel brand. Our flagship product is a deck of Travel Challenge Cards sold on Amazon - a deck that turns any trip into an adventure by challenging travellers to find local oddities, eat unfamiliar food, explore off the tourist trail, and break out of standard sightseeing routines. We sell to two audiences: adventure travellers (the people who use the cards) and gift-givers (the people who buy them for travellers in their life).



Our market is travellers and travel gift-buyers aged roughly 30+. We are not targeting Gen-Z TikTok travellers. Our audience is people with the means and inclination to travel adventurously, and the people who give them thoughtful gifts. The brand sits squarely in this older, more affluent travel space, and our Pinterest strategy reflects that.



We are a small, founder-led business currently travelling nomadically through the Americas. We have a Substack publication, a thousands-strong photo and video library from our travels (Colombia, Costa Rica, Brazil, and more to come), and an Amazon listing with reviews and an established product.



We also have an existing Pinterest account with approximately 12,000 followers, currently branded under a previous business name (Working Traveller). Before you start, we will rename the account to This Big World, update the linked website, and refresh the profile. The legacy pins and boards will be left in place - you will audit them, d
 which to redirect to new destinations, which to delete, and which to keep. You inherit algorithm trust and an existing follower base, not a blank slate.



The Opportunity

We are hiring a dedicated Pinterest Organic Growth Specialist to take complete ownership of our Pinterest channel and turn it into a predictable, long-term acquisition source.



This is not a "post random pins" role. We are looking for someone who genuinely understands Pinterest SEO, visual psychology, click-through behaviour, and content repurposing - and who knows how to translate those into qualified traffic,
 signups, and product sales.



You will work directly with the founder, have significant autonomy over strategy and testing, and own the channel end-to-end. If you are currently limited to basic pin posting and account management but know you are capable of much more strategically, this could be a meaningful long-term role for you.



Your Responsibilities



1. Daily content production

- Publish approximately 10 fresh pins per day, scaling to 15+ pins per day as systems mature.

- Work from our existing photo and video library (thousands of travel assets from Colombia, Costa Rica, Brazil and ongoing destinations), plus our Amazon product photography and any blog content from Substack.

- Work directly with the brand owner to produce and create new unique content aligned with your keyword research and Pinterest SEO strategy — identifying gaps in our library, briefing what photos or videos to capture next, and suggesting content angles that match what people are actually searching for.

- Create multiple pin variations from single source assets — different hooks, different titles, different visual treatments.

- Produce all major pin formats: static pins, idea pins, carousel pins, and video pins.

- Edit photos and short-form vertical video for Pinterest.



2. Account audit and rebuild

- Audit our existing 12k-follower Pinterest account pin-by-pin. Identify which legacy pins still drive impressions, d
 which to redirect to new TBW destinations, which to delete, and which to keep.

- Rebuild the board structure for the TBW brand (gift angles, destination itineraries, adventure travel themes, off-the-beaten-path stories).

- Set up Rich Pins and any integrations between Pinterest and our Amazon listing.

- Document a SEO strategy and publishing plan you will execute on an ongoing basis.



3. Pinterest SEO and keyword research

- Perform deep keyword research within Pinterest for the adventure travel and gift markets.

- Research trends and seasonal search opportunities (Christmas gift season starts in September on Pinterest).

- Optimise pin titles, descriptions, hashtags, boards, and metadata.

- Build keyword-rich descriptions designed to increase discovery, saves, outbound clicks, and ranking inside Pinterest search.

- Treat Pinterest as a visual search engine, not a social media platform.



4. Strategy, testing, and optimisation

- Develop scalable pin templates and systems.

- Identify winning formats and double-down on them. A/B test hooks, titles, imagery, pin styles, and posting times.

- Stay current with Pinterest algorithm changes and best practice. The platform shifts and we need you to shift with it.



5. Reporting and analytics

- Provide weekly performance summaries covering pin output, top performers, and any tests in flight.

- Provide monthly reports covering: impressions, saves, outbound clicks, top-performing pins, traffic to our destinations,
 signups generated, and Amazon sales attributable to Pinterest.

- Use Amazon Attribution links on every pin driving to our Amazon listing, so we can measure your impact on actual sales — not just Pinterest's internal click numbers.

- We care about real metrics: Substack signups, Amazon sales, and discount code redemptions. Pinterest's own dashboard is directional, not a KPI.



Required Experience

- Hands-on Pinterest organic growth experience — accounts you have grown yourself, not accounts you have inherited or merely managed.

- Demonstrable track record of growing Pinterest accounts from low to high monthly views and outbound clicks (screenshots will be required).

- Strong Pinterest SEO knowledge — keyword research, fresh pin strategy, board structure, current algorithm understanding.

- Ability to create high-converting pins — strong visual instincts, understanding of hooks, curiosity, and click psychology.

- Canva design skills (or Photoshop equivalent).

- Short-form vertical video editing skills (Capcut, Premiere, or equivalent).

- Experience with Pinterest scheduling and research tools such as Tailwind and PinClicks (or equivalents).

- Experience creating multiple Pinterest concepts from a single blog post or source asset.

- Confident written English. You will be writing pin descriptions, board descriptions, and SEO copy.

- Self-direction. We do not want to micromanage you. We want to brief you and trust you to run with it.

- Reliable internet, your own equipment, ability to work 40 hours a week consistently.



Bonus Experience (preferred, not required)

- Pinterest traffic to Amazon listings specifically.

- Shopify or Amazon as a traffic destination.

- Travel content experience or genuine interest in travel.

- Experience with Rich Pins and Pinterest-Shopify integrations.



What We Don't Want

xxx  Random pin posting without strategy

xxx  Focus on impressions or saves as the goal (these are directional metrics, not outcomes)

xxx  Generic Canva templates with no hook, no curiosity, no point of view

xxx  Low-quality designs or recycled aesthetics that look like every other travel brand

xxx. Anyone who cannot show real traffic and sales results from past work

xxx  Agencies, outsourced teams, or middlemen

xxx. General social media managers without specific Pinterest expertise

xxx Anyone who treats this as a 6-month gig before moving to the next thing



What We Offer

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

- Starting salary: USD $600-$800 per month, with room to grow to $1,000 for candidates who can demonstrate strong existing results.

- 13th month bonus.

- Compensation increases over time as you prove the strategy and results.

- Genuine long-term role with significant upside as we scale.

- Direct collaboration with the founder.

- Clear ownership of the channel. You have autonomy and you are accountable for results.

- Opportunity to shape the role over time - as the channel matures, you may move into a wider growth role.



How To Apply

This is a deliberately detailed application. We do this because we want serious applicants and we want to filter out copy-paste applications at the start. If the steps below feel like too much work, this role is not for you.



Step 1: Send us our application

Subject line: "Pinterest Specialist - [Your Name]"

In the body of the
, please include:

- Brief introduction about yourself.

- Pinterest accounts you have personally managed (URLs).

- Before/after analytics screenshots showing growth you drove.

- 2-3 examples of specific pins you created that performed well, with the metrics (saves, outbound clicks, traffic driven).

- Your Pinterest SEO methodology in 3-4 sentences - how you approach ranking in a visual search engine.

- Tools you currently use (e.g. Tailwind, PinClicks, Canva, etc).

- Your view on the state of Pinterest in 2026 - what is working right now and what is not.

- Your time zone, working hours, and earliest start date.



Step 2: Test task

If selected for the next stage, you will be asked to complete a short test task. This is unpaid and gives us a clear view of how you think and what you produce. Details will be sent to shortlisted candidates.



Step 3: Video interview

If selected after the test task, you will be invited to a video interview.



Step 4: Paid trial

Successful candidates start with a one-month paid trial at the full agreed salary. At the end of month one, both parties d
 whether to continue. If we continue, this is a long-term role.



Why This Role Is Different

- This is a genuine opportunity to become the Pinterest growth lead for a growing brand.

- We are not hiring someone to manage social media. We are hiring someone to own a channel, build it from an established but neglected foundation, and turn it into a measurable acquisition engine for years to come.

- If that excites you, we want to hear from you.



We respond to qualified applications within 48 hours.

title: Clinical Intake Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to join our remote team as a Clinical Intake Manager. This role plays a critical part in ensuring smooth, accurate, and timely patient intake processes, supporting clinical coordination, and maintaining high-quality documentation standards for U.S.-based healthcare operations.



You are responsible for overseeing patient intake workflows, reviewing clinical documentation, and coordinating care-related requirements with internal teams and external healthcare providers in California. You will play a key role in ensuring that all patient information is complete, accurate, and properly communicated to support hospice and home health operations.



Key Responsibilities

- Manage and oversee end-to-end clinical intake operations and patient assessment workflows

- Review, verify, and analyze medical charts for accuracy, completeness, and compliance

- Coordinate closely with internal tea
mbers (e.g., Camillo) regarding patient intake requirements and updates

- Communicate effectively with U.S.-based physicians, nurses, and healthcare professionals

- Support hospice, home health, and clinical case coordination processes

- Ensure timely documentation, updates, and escalation of clinical concerns when necessary

- Assist in improving intake workflows, efficiency, and overall quality standards

- Maintain accuracy and confidentiality in handling patient health information (PHI)



Qualifications

- Registered Nurse (RN) license preferred

- NCLEX passer is an advantage but not required

- Must have prior experience in Home Health (HH) and/or Hospice care

- Experience in clinical intake, case management, or healthcare virtual assistant roles is highly preferred

- Strong English communication skills (both written and verbal) for coordination with U.S. healthcare teams

- Strong attention to detail, especially in reviewing and validating medical charts

- Ability to work independently in a remote/WFH setup



Preferred Traits

- Experience handling high-volume clinical intake environments

- Strong critical thinking and clinical judgment skills

- Highly organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable, proactive, and self-motivated

- Able to work under minimal supervision while maintaining accuracy and efficiency



Technical Requirements

- Stable Internet Connection: Minimum of 100 Mbps (wired connection preferred)

- Backup Internet: Secondary internet source (e.g., pocket WiFi or backup ISP)

- Backup Power Supply: UPS or generator to ensure continuity during power interruptions

- Noise-Canceling Headset

- Quiet and professional home working environment

- Laptop/desktop capable of handling multitasking and secure clinical systems



Competitive compensation based on experience will be discussed during the final stage of the recruitment process.



How to apply:

If you have a strong background as a Clinical Intake Manager and are eager to continue building your career in home health, we encourage you to apply.

title: Interview Appointment Booker – Music School
description:
Interview Appointment Booker – Music School

Job Summary

We are an established music school in New York City, seeking a highly organized and enthusiastic Interview Appointment Booker to support the admissions process at our music school. This part-time, front-line role involves scheduling interviews for prospective students, serving as the first point of contact for families, and ensuring a smooth, welcoming experience.



The ideal candidate has excellent communication skills (especially over the phone), is detail-oriented, and thrives in a customer-facing environment. Experience with scheduling tools, CRM systems (Go High Level), and working in educational or artistic settings is beneficial. Familiarity with organic lead generation (through social media, community engagement, or word-of-mouth) are a strong plus.



Key Responsibilities

Interview Scheduling:

Coordinate and book interview appointments for prospective students with admissions staff or faculty, based on availability and program requirements.



Initial Contact:

Serve as the first point of contact for inquiries from prospective students and their parents regarding interview scheduling. Provide clear information, answer questions about the admissions process, and offer a warm, enthusiastic introduction to the school.



Calendar Management:

Maintain and manage the interview calendar for Admissions Officers (Sales), ensuring optimal use of staff time and avoiding scheduling conflicts.



Follow-Up Communication:

Send confirmations, reminders, and relevant preparation materials to applicants in advance of their interviews.



Data Entry:

Accurately input applicant information and appointment details into the school’s admissions system or CRM.



Collaboration:

Work closely with admissions officers, program heads, and reception staff to ensure a smooth interview experience and a professional, welcoming environment for all visitors.



Required Skills

Strong organizational and time-management abilities



Excellent verbal and written communication skills



Friendly and professional customer service approach, with an enthusiastic and engaging phone manner



Experience with scheduling tools or booking platforms (e.g., Calendly, Acuity, or CRM systems)



Familiarity with admissions processes or arts/music education is a plus



Ideal Background

Experience in phone-based appointment booking, administrative support, or admissions coordination



Understanding of music school environments or educational settings



Spanish language skills are a plus



Experience with organic lead generation (e.g., through social media engagement, community outreach, or word-of-mouth referrals) is a strong advantage



Compensation

This is a part-time position with a performance-based compensation structure:



Base Pay: $4 per hour



Commission: $15 for each prospective student who shows up at the school for a trial lesson. 

Commission: $30 for each prospective student who shows up at the school. completes an interview, and subsequently enrolls in the program.



Payment Model: At the end of each month, your compensation will be calculated two ways:



Total commission earnings based on successful bookings and/or enrollments



For example, if you help 30 students enroll in a month, your commission would be $900.

title: PAID ADS SPECIALIST
description:
We are a fast-growing SEO and e-commerce company in the health and wellness space, managing multiple successful online brands. We are looking for a Paid Ads Specialist to plan, execute, and optimize high-performing digital advertising campaigns that drive traffic, leads, and revenue growth.



This role is ideal for a performance-driven marketer who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in scaling paid acquisition campaigns across multiple platforms, with strong experience in budget management, audience targeting, keyword research, ad creative testing, A/B testing, and campaign optimization. The role requires continuous monitoring of performance metrics and delivering actionable insights to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency (CPL/ROAS). Develop and execute paid advertising strategies across platforms like Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels, with a strong understanding of platform algorithms and ad compliance



Key Responsibilities:

Plan, launch, and manage paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta 
/Instagram), and LinkedIn, and develop multi-platform paid strategies, including TikTok and other relevant channels.

Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitor analysis to improve campaign performance

Develop, test, and optimize ad creatives, copy, and landing page alignment

Manage advertising budgets efficiently to maximize ROI and reduce acquisition costs

Perform continuous A/B testing on ads, audiences, and campaign structures

Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance metrics (CPC, CPL, ROAS, CTR, conversions)

Identify scaling opportunities and implement data-driven optimization strategies

Collaborate with design and marketing teams to ensure high-performing creatives and messaging.

Leverage hands-on experience with platform algorithms and ad compliance to optimize campaign performance while ensuring strict adherence to advertising policies, platform guidelines, and regulatory standards.



What We’re Looking For

At least 2 years of experience in e-commerce or digital marketing is highly preferred.

 Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, including attribution, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization 

 Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new advertising platforms, AI tools, and evolving digital marketing systems, with a proactive approach to staying updated on and exploring emerging industry trends.

Experience using CRM, tracking tools, analytics, and reporting platforms (Google Analytics, Pixel setup, conversion tracking) 

Experience with retargeting, lookalike audiences, and scaling campaigns

Knowledge of creative strategy for paid ads (hooks, angles, ad copy frameworks)

Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, reporting dashboards, or workflow software to improve marketing operations 



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) improvement and consistency

Click-Through Rate (CTR) optimization across campaigns

Conversion Rate improvement from paid traffic

Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) efficiency

Campaign scaling performance without loss of ROI

Accuracy and consistency of reporting insights

Nice to Have

Experience with health & wellness or DTC e-commerce brands 

Experience optimizing
 revenue and customer retention funnels 

Familiarity with A/B testing tools and conversion optimization strategies



Schedule 

Full 8-hour graveyard shift required 

Must be fully available for US hours 



What We Offer

Full-time remote role 

Training provided 

Growth opportunity into a higher leadership role





How to Apply

Please submit a complete application that includes your resume and a thoughtful, original cover letter. In your cover letter, naturally incorporate the phrase “I love coffee” and share something about yourself that isn’t reflected in your resume. Also answer the following screening questions. 





1. Describe your experience with paid advertising, particularly on TikTok Ads. What does your typical daily workflow look like when managing and optimizing e-commerce campaigns? Please include the platforms you’ve worked with (e.g., TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, Google Ads, etc.).

2. Do you have experience working with platform algorithms and ensuring ad compliance while optimizing performance? If yes, briefly provide an example.



All applications will be carefully reviewed to assess alignment with the role’s requirements. Shortlisted will receive an
 invite for the next steps.

Corporate travelers

Executives

Relocation clients

Insurance housing guests

Event groups

Production crews

Extended-stay guests

You will help us identify, contact, follow up with, and convert potential booking sources such as:



Corporate housing managers

Universities

Local businesses with visiting teams, executives, or project-based workers



The goal is to generate qualified conversations that can turn into direct bookings, corporate stays, mid-term rentals, or longer-term furnished housing contracts.

Building targeted lead lists of companies and decision makers

Finding accurate contact information

Creating
, LinkedIn, and phone outreach campaigns

Writing outreach messages that position the homes properly

Contacting prospects and following up consistently

Tracking every lead, conversation, and follow-up in a CRM or spreadsheet

Booking qualified calls or conversations with interested prospects

Helping move interested leads toward direct bookings or contracts

Coordinating with our team on pricing, availability, and property details

Testing different outreach angles and improving what works

We want someone who can think, execute, follow up, and improve the process without needing to be micromanaged.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit if you have experience with one or more of the following:



Corporate housing lead generation

Mid-term rental lead generation

Short-term rental direct booking outreach

Furnished rental sales

Relocation housing

Insurance / ALE housing outreach

Hospitality B2B sales

Hotel group sales

Vacation rental direct booking campaigns

Property management lead generation

Executive travel or temporary housing sales

Required Skills

B2B cold outreach

 outreach

LinkedIn prospecting

Phone follow-up

Lead list building

CRM or spreadsheet tracking

Follow-up discipline

Sales pipeline management

Clear written communication

Booking qualified calls

Understanding premium/luxury positioning

Working independently and moving quickly



Experience with tools like Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Airtable, Google Sheets, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Clay, or similar tools is a plus.
