In the first 30–60 days, we want to see:



A targeted list of corporate, relocation, insurance, medical, and extended-stay prospects

Outreach campaigns actively running

Consistent follow-up with qualified leads

Interested companies entering the pipeline

Qualified calls or booking inquiries generated

Clear weekly reporting on activity and results

Early direct booking or corporate housing opportunities created



The long-term goal is to build a repeatable outreach system that consistently generates direct bookings, corporate housing leads, and furnished rental revenue.

title: Founding Online ESL Teacher for Young Learners Ages 6–7
description:
We are building a quality-first online English foundation program for young Chinese learners aged 6–7 who are complete beginners or near-beginners in English.



This is not a random teacher-booking platform, and not a typical ESL class.



We are looking for a very small number of truly suitable founding teachers who can help us build the first classroom standard.



Class model:

- Online small-group teaching

- 1 teacher + 4 children

- Fixed teacher

- Fixed students

- Fixed time slot

- Around 25 minutes per class

- Main teaching hours: 4:30 PM – 9:00 PM Philippine time

- One full learning cycle: around 48 weeks



Who we are looking for:



You may be:

- an ESL teacher with young learner experience

- a kindergarten or preschool teacher

- an early childhood education teacher

- a preschool / kindergarten English teacher

- a bilingual or international school young learner teacher



We care less about your title and more about whether you are truly suitable for teaching 6–7-year-old complete beginners in an online 1v4 small-group class.



Required qualities:



We are looking for someone who:

- has experience teaching children aged 5–8 or early primary learners

- genuinely enjoys teaching young children

- understands young learners’ emotions, attention span, and classroom behavior

- can gently but effectively manage shy, silent, distracted, overexcited, or restless children

- can use TPR, gestures, pictures, repetition, routines, and scaffolding to help children understand and participate

- has strong on-camera presence and a warm, child-friendly personality

- has clear, natural, and stable English pronunciation

- is willing to follow lesson SOPs, receive training, and join post-class reviews

- has long-term cooperation potential



Bonus points:

- online young learner teaching experience

- 1v4 or small-group teaching experience

- experience with ClassIn or similar online teaching platforms

- Cambridge Power Up / YLE / Cambridge curriculum experience

- kindergarten / preschool / early childhood education background

- real young learner teaching video samples



Cooperation:



The early stage may start with part-time / trial cooperation.



If both sides are a strong fit, we hope this can grow into stable long-term monthly cooperation.



Because the learning cycle is around 48 weeks, we strongly prefer teachers who are willing to stay with the children for at least one full learning cycle.



For a highly suitable founding teacher, we are willing to offer:

- PHP 40,000–50,000 per month, depending on workload, responsibilities, availability, and fit

- stable long-term cooperation opportunity

- lesson SOP and training support

- opportunity to grow with the founding team

- possible future path toward Lead Teacher / Teacher Trainer / Teaching Quality Support



Application materials:



Please prepare:



1. CV / resume



2. A 3–5 minute self-introduction video — required



In your self-introduction video, please include:

- your name and teaching background

- your experience with young learners, especially ages 5–8

- your online teaching experience, if any

- why you think you may be suitable for 6–7-year-old beginner learners

- one example of how you handled a young child who was silent, distracted, emotional, overexcited, or unwilling to participate



Applications without a self-introduction video will not be prioritized.



3. Previous teaching video — strongly preferred



This is especially helpful if:

- the students are aged 5–8

- it is an online class

- it is a group class

- it shows your real teaching style, energy, voice, TPR, and classroom interaction



4. Available teaching hours



Please clearly state your availability, especially between 4:30 PM and 9:00 PM Philippine time.



5. Equipment and teaching environment



Please briefly share your:

- device

- headset / microphone

- camera

- internet connection

- teaching space



Selection process:

1. Application screening

2. Self-introduction video review

3. Video interview

4. Short paid teaching audition

5. Part-time / trial cooperation

6. Long-term cooperation if both sides are a strong fit



Important note:



We are not mass hiring.



We are not looking for the most teachers.



We are looking for the right teachers.



Generic applications will not be prioritized. Please read the role carefully and apply only if you truly enjoy teaching young children and believe you may be suitable for beginner learners in an online small-group class.



To show that you have read this post carefully, please start your application message with: “Benova Young Learner”.



If you have patience, classroom energy, clear English, strong young learner teaching ability, and are interested in helping build a quality-first young learner English program from the early stage, we would love to hear from you.

title: E-Commerce Operations Manager – DTC Shopify Brand (Full-Time)
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a US-based direct-to-consumer supplement brand scaling aggressively on Meta. We currently do $300K+/month in revenue across Shopify and Checkout Champ, with a monthly recurring subscription program driving significant MRR. Our backend is already systemized — AI-powered
 automation, structured SOPs, established supplier relationships, and a two-person leadership team (Founder/CEO + Brand Manager) who are actively building this into an eight-figure brand.

This is not a startup figuring things out. This is a scaling machine that needs a qualified operator to own the backend.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We need an E-Commerce Operations Manager — not a virtual assistant, not someone who "wants to learn e-commerce." We need someone who has BEEN the backend operator at a DTC brand doing at least $100K/month on Shopify. Someone who already knows what it feels like when 200+ orders come in per day and things need to run perfectly. Someone who has processed refunds at 11pm to prevent a chargeback. Someone who has built a daily PNL from scratch in Google Sheets. Someone who has monitored payment gateway approval rates and knows what a MID is.

If that's not you, please do not apply. We respect your time and ours.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Customer Operations (Escalated Tickets Only)

We have full AI automation handling tier-one customer
s (where's my order, product questions, general inquiries). Your job is NOT answering
s all day. Your job is handling the 10-20% of tickets that get escalated to a human — refunds, subscription cancellations, chargeback threats, angry customers, and anything requiring account access or judgment. Maximum 12-hour response time on escalated tickets. Chargebacks are the #1 threat to our business. You need to understand this in your bones.

Financial Reporting & Analytics

You own the daily PNL. Every single day, you pull revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, net profit, and unit economics into Google Sheets. You track subscription metrics — new enrollments, cancellations, churn rate, MRR. You monitor average order value, chargeback rate, and gateway approval rates. You flag anomalies before anyone has to ask. If revenue drops 30% on a random Tuesday, we should hear it from you first — not discover it ourselves.

Operational Oversight & Brand Monitoring

You monitor order fulfillment and tracking daily. You check our comment moderation platform (BrandWise) every single day — reviewing every comment on every ad, hiding negative comments, flagging trends, and reporting on brand sentiment. You monitor payment processing health across multiple MIDs and flag any issues with approval rates, reserves, or underwriting requests. You communicate with our fulfillment supplier when needed. You are the person who catches problems before they become emergencies.



THE TOOLS WE USE

You don't need to know every tool on this list — but you need to know most of them, and you'll be trained on the rest.



Shopify (REQUIRED — non-negotiable, you must be proficient)

Checkout Champ (huge bonus — if you know this, you move to the front of the line)

Google Sheets (REQUIRED — daily PNL, reporting, unit economics)

Helpdesk platform experience (we use Commslayer, but if you've used Gorgias, Zendesk, Front, Freshdesk, or similar — that works)

BrandWise or similar comment moderation tool

Parcel Panel or similar order tracking tool

Disputifier or similar chargeback management tool

Hubstaff (REQUIRED — time tracking is mandatory, installed from day one, no exceptions)

Klaviyo 
 marketing — bonus)

Loop Subscriptions (bonus)

Meta Ads Manager (read-only — understanding ad metrics is a bonus)

AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT — you should be comfortable using AI to work faster)



REQUIREMENTS — DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT THESE

Fluent English — written and spoken, no exceptions

Have worked on a DTC e-commerce brand doing $100K+/month on Shopify (1+ year is ideal, please be completely honest about your experience. We will be able to verify your experience through connections in the ecommerce space.)

Experience with subscription-based products (monthly recurring billing, cancellations, retention)

Experience building and maintaining daily PNL reports in Google Sheets

Experience with refund processing and chargeback prevention workflows

Experience with at least one helpdesk/customer support platform

Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking — this is not optional

Available to work 40 hours/week on a consistent schedule

Able to respond to urgent escalated tickets within 12 hours maximum



STRONG BONUSES (not required, but you'll stand out)

Checkout Champ experience

Supplement or health brand experience

Experience monitoring payment gateway approval rates and MID health

BrandWise or comment moderation experience

Experience working directly with Chinese suppliers/fulfillment partners

Disputifier or chargeback automation experience



WHAT WE OFFER

$1,500/month USD salary (negotiable for exceptional candidates with proven experience)

Full-time, long-term position — this is not a project or a trial

You will NOT be alone — you'll work directly with the Founder and Brand Manager daily

Full onboarding and training on our specific systems, SOPs, and brand

AI automation already handles the bulk of customer inquiries — you focus on high-value work

Performance bonuses tied to brand growth

Opportunity to grow into a senior operations role as we scale to eight figures



WHAT WE WILL NOT TOLERATE

Time theft. Hubstaff is active from day one. If you're not comfortable with screen monitoring and verified hours, this is not the role for you.

Fabricated experience. If you claim you've worked on a scaling DTC brand and you haven't, we will find out — quickly.

Slow response on urgent tickets. When a customer threatens a chargeback, that ticket cannot sit for 24 hours. This role requires urgency when urgency is needed.



HOW TO APPLY

Do NOT apply through the OnlineJobs.ph messaging system.

Message us directly on WhatsApp: +1 (516)
In your WhatsApp message, you MUST include ALL of the following or you will not receive a response:



Your full name

The specific DTC/e-commerce brands you've worked with and their approximate monthly revenue

The tools you are proficient in from the list above

Your experience with subscription models (what platforms, how you handled cancellations and chargeback prevention)

Your experience with PNL reporting (how you built it, what metrics you tracked, what tools you used)

Your availability to start



If your message does not include these six items, we will not respond. This is intentional — we need someone who reads thoroughly, follows instructions precisely, and communicates clearly. This is your first test.

We are filling this position quickly. Qualified candidates will be contacted for a video call within 12-24 hours of their WhatsApp message.



We look forward to hearing from you.
